chapter: Carnegie Hall, nicknames and later career
title: What Dickie Wells and Sweets gave the band; Freddie Green as rock
summary: Basie says Dickie gave drive, pure horn and humor; Sweets was a stylist; Freddie was the rock of Gibraltar.

story.theme_name: Trombonists: who they heard, admired and learned from
story.community_name: Talking trombonists: who played the slide and how

blocks.x: What did Dickie give your band?
What did Dickie give your band when it comes to sound?
I don't know. Dickie gave the band a lot of drive, a lot of pure, good horn and (Inaudible) a lot of humor.
Humor? Yeah. Anybody else give humor to the band, if you can recall?
Well, I -- who else? (Inaudible) Sweets did.
Those two gave humor. Freddy didn't give humor.
No. Freddy's pretty solid; rock of Gibraltar.
